Granny Gear look — v16

Dark base. Yellow on Home, sign-in, Sensors, Settings; Granny Gear blue on the Training screen (in session). App, broadcaster and platform are all installable PWAs. Sensor rows animate once connected (heart beats, bolt flashes, pedal spins, Click pulses); a connecting row pulses its icon ring; offline rows dim. Login goes straight to Training. Class plans come only from the studio (no import on the phone). Cadence rides in green on the power trace; the broadcaster shows each rider's power on a gradient gauge with a needle. Power shows a 7-zone bar (% of FTP) with a live marker plus a power trace; heart rate rolls on white graph paper with a live needle; the chip icons are live too: pedal spins at the cadence, speed needle sweeps, bolt flashes with power, heart beats at the heart rate (all animated here as in the app). Icons are white strokes; the coloured left borders from v2 come back on the Home tiles. Charts are smoothed with a soft fill and a live dot. Login takes a username only: no recent riders, no Add rider (both live on the platform). Background: generated studio photo with 300 Pro-style bikes; a real photo of the room can replace it.

Finish: when the plan's last interval ends the track fades to the straight, each rider figure crosses the line in finishing order with arms raised (small stick figures, one per rider, username under), confetti in zone colours, then the podium three and everyone's kJ / avg W.
